authenticated_calls_made.purpose: measure wire size and compression; 1 unique symbol (SPY, already needed); not written to the cache

account_plan: NOT VERIFIABLE VIA API: Tiingo documents no usage/plan endpoint and returns no rate-limit headers
account_plan_check_required: a human logs in at https://www.tiingo.com/account/api/usage and records plan, unique symbols used this month and bandwidth used
reset_rules: hourly requests reset hourly; daily requests at midnight EST; monthly bandwidth on the 1st at midnight EST (Tiingo docs overview)
